data: In the second chart, at which iteration does RAND achieve an F1-score of over 96?

The question asks for the iteration at which RAND achieves an F1-score of over 96 in the second chart. The second chart is the one on the right side of the figure, titled "With Bigram Features." 

Looking at the line representing RAND in this chart, we can see that it starts below 96 and gradually increases. By examining the y-axis values, we can determine that RAND crosses the 96% mark around iteration 8. Therefore, the answer is iteration 8.
